ABOUT_MEGHACONNECT_TITLE: A connected workflow for citizens and officials
ABOUT_MEGHACONNECT_TEXT: MeghaConnect helps citizens register securely, create appointment requests, and follow application progress while enabling DEO, Approver, Admin, and Citizen roles to work in a controlled digital process.
ABOUT_POINT_KYC_TEXT: Citizens can register using EPIC or Aadhaar based verification with OTP and photo capture.
ABOUT_POINT_APPOINTMENT_TEXT: Logged-in citizens can create and track appointment requests without re-entering personal details.
ABOUT_POINT_VISITOR_TEXT: DEO users can identify existing visitors, register new visitors, and support walk-in workflows.
ABOUT_POINT_WORKFLOW_TEXT: Appointment requests move through clear review stages for DEO, CMO, Approver, HCM, and Admin roles.
ABOUT_POINT_AUDIT_TEXT: Important actions are tracked with request IDs, status updates, and review history.
ABOUT_POINT_SECURE_TEXT: Citizen, DEO, Approver, and Admin users get access only to the screens and actions meant for their role.
FAQ_TEXT: Simple answers for citizens using MeghaConnect.
FAQ_A_REGISTER: A citizen can register from the visitor registration page by verifying identity details, OTP, and a photo as required.
FAQ_A_EPIC: Yes. You can use your EPIC or Voter ID number when the EPIC verification service is available.
FAQ_A_AADHAAR: Yes. Aadhaar QR based KYC can populate your details when the Aadhaar flow is enabled.
FAQ_Q_SAME_MOBILE: Can multiple family members use the same mobile number?
FAQ_A_SAME_MOBILE: Yes. Multiple registrations may use the same mobile number. If needed, the system will ask for EPIC to identify the correct profile.
FAQ_A_LOGIN: Citizens log in with registered mobile number and OTP. Staff users log in with assigned username and password.
FAQ_Q_MULTIPLE_REG: What should I do if my mobile number has multiple registrations?
FAQ_A_MULTIPLE_REG: Enter the EPIC number when prompted so the system can select the correct citizen profile.
FAQ_Q_APPOINTMENT: How can I create an appointment?
FAQ_A_APPOINTMENT: After citizen login, open the dashboard and choose Book New Appointment. Your profile details are loaded automatically.
FAQ_Q_NOTIFICATIONS: How will I receive OTP or notifications?
FAQ_A_NOTIFICATIONS: OTP is sent to your registered mobile number. SMS or WhatsApp notifications may be used if enabled by the project configuration.

HOME_FAQ_APPROVAL_Q: Kumno approval bad scheduling la pyniaid?
